title: Synergizing Evidence Retrieval and Utilization for Self-Improving Multimodal Scientific Document Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22837v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific document reasoning requires an agent to acquire and integrate evidence distributed across text, figures, and tables. Retrieval can identify relevant sources while missing complementary support, and answer-level feedback alone does not reveal whether an error stems from evidence acquisition or evidence use. We present an agentic Retriever--Perceiver--Reasoner framework for multimodal scientific document reasoning. The Retriever sequentially selects source-aligned evidence under a context budget. Given the selected evidence and question, the Perceiver constructs a question-conditioned latent ontology, an implicit organization of multimodal evidence in a shared continuous space. The Reasoner combines this latent guidance with the original sources to produce grounded answers. translated_title: 协同证据检索与利用以实现自我改进的多模态科学文档推理
translated_abstract: 科学文档推理要求智能体获取并整合分布于文本、插图和表格中的证据。检索能够识别相关来源，但可能遗漏互补性的支持信息；而仅有答案层面的反馈无法揭示错误究竟源于证据获取还是证据利用。我们提出了一个用于多模态科学文档推理的智能体式“检索器—感知器—推理器”（Retriever-Perceiver-Reasoner）框架。检索器在上下文预算约束下按序选择与来源对齐的证据。在给定所选证据和问题的情况下，感知器构建一个以问题为条件的潜在本体，即多模态证据在共享连续空间中的一种隐式组织形式。推理器将这一潜在引导与原始来源相结合，生成有据可依的答案。我们通过诊断引导的协同进化来训练这三个组件：交替更新在共享的答案奖励下对其进行优化，同时检索潜力……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Retriever-Perceiver-Reasoner智能体框架，通过诊断引导的协同进化训练来协同优化证据检索与利用，从而实现自我改进的多模态科学文档推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agentic Retriever-Perceiver-Reasoner framework that synergizes evidence retrieval and utilization through diagnostic-guided co-evolution, enabling self-improving multimodal scientific document reasoning.
